requested_outcome: Implement REASONING_ONLY_MAX_TOKENS_GUARD_V1 in the shared structured Contract Runtime.
operational_definition: For every supported production adapter projection and structured final-artifact contract, detect the exact finite output shape containing known reasoning but no text, tool, unknown block, or visible artifact at a max-token terminal boundary; emit a typed failure before parsing, remember an exact negative route capability, avoid redispatching the same fingerprint, and use only an already-configured distinct route before typed fail-close.
forbidden_narrowing: no prompt, model, route identity, contract, retry-count, fallback-count, or budget change

current_behavior_and_evidence.failure_path: empty normalized text reaches conversion and can become generic ContractOutputLimitExhaustedError with repeated same-route output-budget expansion

allowed_changes: typed Contract Runtime recovery and terminal errors
protected_unchanged_behavior: Draft, Final Review, Maintenance, Canon, StoryState, READY authority
selected_approach: ModelGateway centrally projects adapter-retained raw response state into one privacy-safe typed shape. It detects the exact invariant and records a route-fingerprint-bound negative final-artifact qualification. Contract Runtime skips the remaining same-route attempts, advances only through its existing immutable route schedule, and otherwise raises a typed final-artifact capability exhaustion.

rejected_alternatives.typed_fail_close_only: containment only; would ignore an existing independent fallback
rejected_alternatives.alternate_contract: changes business authority and is forbidden
rejected_alternatives.provider_native_reservation: PTR7 proved accepted controls were behaviorally ignored
rejected_alternatives.budget_expansion: does not reserve final output and is forbidden
rejected_alternatives.adapter_only_policy: adapter does not own contract recovery and would diverge by provider

rollback_path: Revert the additive output-shape field, typed errors, final_artifact qualification outcome, and Contract Runtime branch. Existing qualification table rows remain structurally compatible and can be ignored by the prior reader; no manuscript or StoryState migration is required.
completion_boundary: A production-shaped reasoning-only primary attempt must avoid parser/schema/generic output-limit handling and continue through canonical conversion and domain validation on an existing distinct fallback. No-route exhaustion must remain typed fail-close.
